content.title: Community Quilt Challenge
content.summary: Threads of Arvada is a community art project celebrating Colorado's 150th anniversary and the Arvada Flour Mill's 100th birthday, inviting participants to create wallhanging quilts using custom reproduction fabrics from historic flour sacks. Registration costs $25, and participants must submit their quilts by September 30, 2026, with a public exhibition planned for Fall 2026. The theme for the quilts is \"A Day in Arvada,\" reflecting personal creativity and community expression.
content.body:
## Threads of Arvada - The Arva Pride Community Quilt Challenge

Threads of Arvada is a community-based art project commemorating the 150th anniversary of the State of Colorado and the 100th birthday of the Arvada Flour Mill, centered on historic fabric designs reproduced from Arva Pride Mill flour sacks.

All registered participants will receive a half yard of quilting cotton with swatches of six vintage patterns and a variety of Arva Pride labels. Registration is $25 per person. You can [register](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog) for **Threads of Arvada** online.

**What:** Local makers are challenged to create their own individual wallhanging quilts using fabrics reproduced from the original printed flour sacks used for Arva Pride flour in the early 20th century.  There will be a special exhibition of these challenge quilts in Fall 2026. All quilts remain the property of their creators.

**Who:** Anyone with a connection to Arvada may participate.

**What:** Create a wallhanging based on the theme “A Day in Arvada”.  The day can be in the past, present or the future. Size restriction - 120” perimeter (e.g., 30 x 30” or 36 x 24”).

**Fabric:** Registrants will receive a kit of custom reproduction fabric based on the original Arva Pride flour sacks which must appear, any amount, on the front of the quilt.

**When:**  April 12, 2026 at the 100th birthday festivities of the Arva Pride Mill at the Historic Mill (5590 Olde Wadsworth Boulevard).

Sept. 30, 2026 - Deadline for finished quilts to be returned.

Fall-Winter 2026 - Public exhibition of quilts - exact dates & location TBA

**Why:**  Quilts are unique expressions of community, of personal creativity, and of a dynamic design tradition that honors the past, celebrates the present, and looks to the future.

Add your name and email to [the mailing list](/list.aspx?ListID=294) for breaking information about classes, event details and more.

**Question?** Contact Project Coordinator - [Lauren Kingsland](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#76131b171f1a02194c1a17030413181d1f1811051a1718124f4636111b171f1a5815191b533344534e46534e34)

> [Register online now](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog) for Threads of Arvada and receive your instructions and reproduction fabric.

## Resources

- View a [short video](https://youtu.be/ZjPqhTAH-9A?si=qXMp1No_UaIMhl9G) on how to add a hanging sleeve to your quilt.
- The [Columbine Quilt Guild in Arvada](http://colombinequiltguild.org) has a mentoring program for technical help. Send an [email](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#99faf6f5ecf4fbf0f7fce8fed9fef4f8f0f5b7faf6f4) to learn more about obtaining a mentor.
- [Little Sandy's Quilt Shop](http://littlesandysquiltshop.com) in West Arvada is offering 10% off supplies with your registration form.
- For inspiration, visit the [Rocky Mountain Quilt Museum](http://rmqm.org) in Golden.
- Other locations for supplies are the [Golden Quilt Company](http://goldenquiltcompany.com) in Golden and [The Craft Box](http://craftboxcolorado.com) in Wheatridge.

Have a resource that should be listed? Contact [Rachael Kuroiwa](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#75071e00071a1c0214351407031411145b1a0712).
